newsitem.title: CANADA: Challenge of Hollinger takeover of Southam fails.
newsitem.headline: Challenge of Hollinger takeover of Southam fails.

text.p: A Canadian court on Monday rejected a legal challenge to Hollinger Inc's takeover of the newspaper chain Southam Inc, the group that had launched the challenge said.

"The Federal Court today rejected a bid by the Council of Canadians to order a judicial review of the Competition Bureau's approval of the takeover of the Southam newspaper chain by Hollinger Inc last May," the public-interest group said.
The court rejected the council's appeal for an extension of the 30-day limit on time in which to apply for a review of the merger, in the process killing the challenge.
Council Chairwoman Maude Barlow said she would recommend to her board that the group appeal the court ruling.
Some Canadians have argued that a concentration of newspaper ownership would reduce diversity of expression.
